messages.author: e26511c35c7ed172
messages.subject: 'Oops!!! rApache...' without an error
parts:
Hi,
I am getting the rApache message "Oops!!! rApache has ..."
although strictly speaking it's not an error but just a warning about
object masking:
(see useful discussion: http://tolstoy.newcastle.edu.au/R/e2/help/06/10/3479.html)

<!--
Loading required package: ellipse
Loading required package: KernSmooth
KernSmooth 2.23 loaded
Copyright M. P. Wand 1997-2009
Loading required package: MASS
Loading required package: nnet
Loading required package: survival
Loading required package: splines

Attaching package: 'car'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:ellipse':
ellipse
-->

Any ideas how to avoid it, beside using different library?
Best Regards, Maciej

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: 'Oops!!! rApache...' without an error
parts:
(going through a backlog of email)

Just comment out the ROutputErrors directive in your apache config.

Jeff
